I understand you want a single $50 refund, but I can’t issue or combine refunds that way. Refunds must be processed per order and can’t exceed the order amount.

Good news: both $25 refunds have already been issued—one for Tuesday and one for last Friday—totaling $50. They’ll appear as two separate credits to your original payment method within 3–5 business days. Issuing another $50 would duplicate the refund, so I can’t do that.

If either credit hasn’t posted after 5 business days, tell me and I’ll check the status. Want me to add “Hand it to me only” and a call-on-arrival note to help prevent this happening again?

messages.text: Hi — I've now had TWO orders in a row that were marked as delivered but never showed up. Both were $25, so I'm out $50 for food I never received. I can see you're able to help with refunds, so let's do this properly: please refund BOTH orders — the one from this week and the identical one from last week. That's the full $50 to my card. I've been patient, but this is the second time I've had to chase this; please go ahead and process both refunds now.
